title: SQL String & Date Functions
description: Master the string and date functions that appear constantly in real-world analytics queries — trimming and parsing text columns, extracting date parts, computing date differences, and handling timezone offsets.
outcomes: You'll handle messy string columns (TRIM, SPLIT_PART, CONCAT, REGEXP_REPLACE), work confidently with date columns (DATE_TRUNC, CURRENT_DATE arithmetic, INTERVAL), and avoid the common timezone trap in reporting queries.
